purpose: Machine-readable G0-G4 action gate rules for Goofish/Xianyu page observation and automation.

gateDefinitions.G0: Public read-only action. It does not depend on private data and does not change account state.
gateDefinitions.G1: Logged-in read-only action. It may reveal private account or business data; output must be redacted.
gateDefinitions.G2: Draft assistance. It may type or prepare content, but must stop before save, submit, send, upload, or publish.
gateDefinitions.G3: Explicit confirmation required. It can change account, item, message, export, permission, or business state.
gateDefinitions.G4: Never proactive. It is payment, order state, refund, shipment, dispute, identity, permission, paid promotion, or internal test.

globalDecisionOrder: If current transition is STOP_BEFORE_ACTION, classify as G3 or G4 and stop.
If route has real order, item, user, chat, account, address, logistics, invoice, or payment parameters, require user context and redact.
If the DOM action text or API name matches a G4 token, stop even if the page is otherwise readable.
If the DOM action text or API name matches a G3 token, ask for explicit action-time confirmation.
If the element is an upload, download, export, save, submit, send, delete, pay, or verify control, stop.
If the current page family has a lower max gate than the action requires, use the higher risk gate.
Only G0/G1 read-only actions may run without another confirmation.

controlTypeRules.link: Use route and transition graph; links to deep parameter pages require user context.
controlTypeRules.button: Classify by visible label, aria label, title, and nearby modal state.
controlTypeRules.inputText: G0/G1 for search and filters; G2 for draft fields; stop before save or submit.
controlTypeRules.textarea: G2 draft only; stop before submit or send.
controlTypeRules.fileInput: G3/G4; never upload without explicit user confirmation.
controlTypeRules.checkboxRadio: G1 for filter; G3/G4 if tied to order, finance, permission, invoice, or publish settings.
controlTypeRules.selectDropdown: G1 for filters; G3/G4 if changing address, logistics, payment, permission, or dispatch rules.
controlTypeRules.downloadControl: G3; do not download data or client installers by default.
controlTypeRules.confirmDialog: G3/G4; do not click confirm without action-time confirmation.

runtimeDecision.ifGateIsG0: Proceed when page and transition are read-only.
runtimeDecision.ifGateIsG1: Proceed with redacted structural observation only.
runtimeDecision.ifGateIsG2: Prepare draft only; stop before upload/save/submit/send/publish.
runtimeDecision.ifGateIsG3: Ask user for explicit action-time confirmation.
runtimeDecision.ifGateIsG4: Do not perform proactively; explain risk and stop.
